<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <!-- SleepRight: night to dawn over a sleep pod; the name breathes in, WAKE BETTER comes up with the sun. -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sr_sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0a0f2a"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#0a0f2a;#0a0f2a;#3a4a8a" keyTimes="0;0.4;1" dur="5s" fill="freeze"/></stop>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a1440"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#1a1440;#1a1440;#f0b080" keyTimes="0;0.4;1" dur="5s" fill="freeze"/></stop>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sr_sun"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff4d0"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#ffc070"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffc070" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sr_pod" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8eef8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8090b0"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#sr_sky)"/>
  <g fill="#fff">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="5s" fill="freeze"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="40" r="1.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="70" r="1"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="1.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="480" cy="30" r="1.5"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="570" cy="90" r="1"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;1;0.4" dur="2.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="140" cy="110" r="1"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;1;0.6" dur="3.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
  </g>
  <circle cx="320" cy="420" r="120" fill="url(#sr_sun)"><animate attributeName="cy" values="420;420;300" keyTimes="0;0.4;1" dur="5s" fill="freeze"/></circle>
  <rect y="290" width="640" height="70" fill="#141a30"/>
  <g transform="translate(320 270)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-28" width="180" height="56" rx="28" fill="url(#sr_pod)" stroke="#c0d0f0"/>
    <rect x="-70" y="-18" width="100" height="26" rx="13" fill="#40507a" opacity="0.8"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.8;0.4;0.8" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
    <circle cx="60" cy="0" r="5" fill="#70e0b0"><animate attributeName="fill" values="#70e0b0;#2a6050;#70e0b0" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
  </g>
  <g fill="#c0d0ff" font-style="italic">
    <text x="420" y="220" font-size="22">z<animate attributeName="y" values="220;160" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>
    <text x="440" y="200" font-size="16">z<animate attributeName="y" values="200;140" dur="3s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0" dur="3s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>
  </g>
  <text x="320" y="120" font-size="64" font-weight="300" fill="#f4f6ff" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="8" opacity="0">SLEEPRIGHT<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="1.6s" fill="freeze"/><animate attributeName="letter-spacing" values="20;8" dur="1.6s" fill="freeze"/></text>
  <text x="320" y="170" font-size="20" fill="#ffe0b0" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="10" opacity="0">WAKE BETTER™<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="1s" begin="3.2s" fill="freeze"/></text>
  <text x="620" y="345" font-size="9" fill="#7080a0" text-anchor="end" font-family="monospace">POD LEASE ONLY. DREAMS REMAIN THE PROPERTY OF SLEEPRIGHT HOLDINGS.</text>
</svg>
name: sleepright_logo
